title: Semantics derived automatically from language corpora necessarily contain human biases

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure the cosine similarity between European American and African American name vectors against pleasant and unpleasant attribute word vectors in the GloVe embedding.

Using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to measure implicit associations between male/female target words and attribute concepts like career/family, math/arts, and science/arts. Also using the Word Embedding Factual Association Test (WEFAT) to correlate the gender association of word vectors (for occupations and androgynous names) with real-world demographic statistics.
